output.question: Where can I find JPMorgan Chase's latest annual report?
output.answer: As of November 11, 2026, JPMorgan Chase & Co.'s latest annual report listed on its Investor Relations site is the 2025 Annual Report & Proxy, released in April 2026. You can find it on the company's Annual Report & Proxy page, which links to the direct PDF of the full 2025 Annual Report: https://www.jpmorganchase.com/content/dam/jpmc/jpmorgan-chase-and-co/investor-relations/documents/annualreport-2025.pdf. The landing page is https://www.jpmorganchase.com/ir/annual-report.

The company provides a direct download link to the complete 2025 Annual Report PDF.
